items.name: Gerald Clayton at the Village Vanguard
items.reason: Jazz pianist in the most legendary jazz basement in the world; listed for Sun 24 Jan (cover estimated at about US$45).

items.name: Studio Museum in Harlem: 'Dreams of This Future' (Peggy Cooper Cafritz collection) and 'Geometries'
items.reason: Black contemporary art in the museum's new Harlem building; both shows on view through February 2027 (admission estimated free).

items.name: Brooklyn Flea + Smorgasburg winter market
items.reason: Indoor vintage and food market, usually every Saturday and Sunday November to March; 2027 venue not yet announced.

negatives: Deep winter: January highs around 4 C, rain or snow on about 11 of 30 days.
NYC Winter Jazzfest's Manhattan marathon is 15 Jan 2027, the week before; it is missed.
Restaurant Week and Broadway Week 2027 dates not announced yet (usually late January to February).
Some event sites were outside this session's network, so the search was thinner than usual.
